description.value: The caster emulates a gold chocobo’s ability to place a halo over their an ally or themselves. The target gains auto-raise, float, and haste: the ability to receive the Reraise status when the subject dies, gently float over the ground by 5 feet, receive +1 bonus to Attack rolls, +1 bonus to Reflex saves, +30 foot movement, and an extra attack if the subject uses a full-attack option. Learned From chocobo family
